name: acp-harnesses
description: Makes any ACP-speaking coding agent selectable as Kiro Crew's backend — Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI — using your own local installs. Registers each harness at gateway startup so it appears in the existing Settings backend selector, resolves the right binary per harness, and speaks each one's ACP dialect. Also restores Kiro Crew's MCP tools on the Claude backend, which the public build leaves empty.
author: mmkhatib
highlights: Claude Code, Gemini CLI and Codex CLI selectable from the stock Settings dropdown
Runs your own local install of each harness — nothing is bundled or downloaded
No file patching: registers in-process at startup, so Kiro Crew updates cannot wipe it
Restores Kiro Crew MCP tools (cron, spawn, monitor) on the Claude backend
Refuses to register rather than half-apply if Kiro Crew's internals move

harnesses.label: Codex CLI
harnesses._note: Codex CLI does not speak ACP natively; it needs an adapter. Install one (e.g. agentclientprotocol/codex-acp) so 'codex-acp' is on PATH, then set enabled=true. Off by default so the backend list only offers harnesses that can actually start.

useCases: Route Kiro Crew sessions through a local Claude Code, Gemini CLI or Codex CLI install instead of kiro-cli.
configuration: Enable and trust the app, restart Kiro Crew, then pick a backend in Settings → agent.acp_backend. On Windows also set agent.sandbox_allow_unsandboxed_exec=true so the harness subprocess may spawn.
